posts.linkedin:
My content system once read “24x7” as “24 x 7.”

It sounded wrong. I kept listening to the recordings.

Some amounts ran into the next word. “4K” became “4 thousand.” “show/hide” turned into nonsense and I noted them all.

I built a pronunciation list. Now every script is checked for words the voice would say wrong before it is recorded. I do not skip this step, every time.

I used to record first and fix later. Now I check first. It takes longer and sounds right every time.

The voice does not forgive small mistakes. I am still working it out. If you build things, I would be glad to connect.

replies.reply: Hi [Name], thanks for messaging. I build AI chatbots that answer customer questions and collect name, number and requirement automatically. What do you want customers to do — call you, WhatsApp you, book a slot or fill a form? Once I know that, I can share the fixed price: INR 2,999 or INR 4,999 plus INR 299/month maintenance. You pay only after you approve the work. Prefer a WhatsApp chat or details here?

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Hi [Name], glad the post helped. I build chatbots for any small business that talks to customers on WhatsApp, Instagram or phone — shops, cafes, clinics, salons, coaching centres. What kind of business do you run, and what do customers ask you most often?

replies.if_they_say: will customers find it annoying to share details?
replies.reply: Hi [Name], good question. The bot only asks name and number in the first two or three messages, so it feels like a normal conversation, not a form. What kind of business do you run, and what do customers usually ask you first?
